company.name: PetBae
company.shortDescription: PetBae is a mobile app and platform that links pet owners to vetted individual pet sitters.
company.description: PetBae is a revolutionary C2C pet care platform that puts individual pet sitters and home-based care at the forefront of its value proposition. The home-grown brand understands that pet owners desire personalized, trustworthy care for their beloved companions, which is why PetBae offers a comprehensive range of home-based, cage-free pet care solutions. With PetBae, jet-setting pet owners can select vetted pet sitters in their area, providing them with peace of mind as they embark on their summer holidays or business trips. Our platform prioritizes tailored care, cost-effectiveness, and convenience, making PetBae the ultimate solution for pet care in today's busy world. Rest assured, your pet's well-being and happiness are at the core of PetBae's mission, ensuring that every pet receives the individualized care they deserve.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $503,744, or 71.58% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,602,360 to $4,982,964, a 3.11x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
